title: 🔬 Strategic Defence Milestones — Semiconductor ATMP Sanand, Agni-III & BEL-Safran HAMMER JV
executiveSummary: Commercial memory module production commenced at Sanand Gujarat under India Semiconductor Mission.
masterKeyFacts: Commercial memory module production commenced at Sanand Gujarat under India Semiconductor Mission.
Agni-III intermediate-range ballistic missile (3,000-3,500 km range, 1,500 kg payload) tested.
Cmde Milind M Mokashi assumed command of CTF 154 (47 nations, CMF Bahrain) for maritime training.
Joint venture to manufacture HAMMER (AASM 125 kg-1,000 kg) air-to-surface weapon for Rafale jets.
President Murmu became 1st President to fly in indigenous LCH Prachand (HAL, ceiling >5,000 m).
Man Portable Air Defence System developed by RCI tested successfully.

subEvents.title: PM Modi inaugurates Micron's ₹22,500 Crore Semiconductor ATMP facility in Sanand
facts: Commercial memory module production commenced at Sanand Gujarat under India Semiconductor Mission.

subEvents.title: India successfully test-fires Agni-III missile from Chandipur Odisha
facts: Agni-III intermediate-range ballistic missile (3,000-3,500 km range, 1,500 kg payload) tested.

subEvents.title: Indian Navy assumes command of Combined Task Force 154 (CTF 154) in Bahrain
facts: Cmde Milind M Mokashi assumed command of CTF 154 (47 nations, CMF Bahrain) for maritime training.

subEvents.title: BEL and Safran tie up to produce HAMMER precision-guided weapons in India
facts: Joint venture to manufacture HAMMER (AASM 125 kg-1,000 kg) air-to-surface weapon for Rafale jets.

subEvents.title: President Murmu flies sortie in LCH Prachand at Jaisalmer
facts: President Murmu became 1st President to fly in indigenous LCH Prachand (HAL, ceiling >5,000 m).

subEvents.title: DRDO conducts successful flight trials of VSHORADS missile at Chandipur
facts: Man Portable Air Defence System developed by RCI tested successfully.
